validity_notes: CRITICAL: H1 AX_consistency_mean=0.0 because the metric computes LCP between DISTINCT product pages (different content). The intended metric should compute LCP within product-subtree anchored regions (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo), not full-page AX trees. Full-page LCP between different products is expected to be ~0.

CRITICAL: Only 4 task families available in the shopping dataset (<5 threshold). The shopping_admin fallback (184 tasks, 42 families) returns HTTP 404 on the running Docker container, preventing expansion.

CRITICAL: SHA mutation detection failed — setting a data-s attribute on a button element did not change the AX tree. This may be because: (a) custom data attributes are not exposed in the accessibility tree, or (b) the mutation needs to affect visible content. This affects H2_STAGEHAND_RECOMPUTED stability gate.

IMPORTANT: BrowserGym-core 0.14.3, AgentLab 0.4.2, WebGym 292k are NOT installed. These are required for H3 (WebGym diverse census), H4 (Gate0 multi-step), and the BrowserGym component of the measurement pipeline.
IMPORTANT: HF_TOKEN is not set, preventing WebGym dataset download and Mind2Web-2 access. These are required for H3 and H5 orthogonal fallback verification.

NOTEWORTHY: The Docker container has an existing container 'nervous_lamarr' running with port 7770 mapped, suggesting a previous experiment left it running. The image digest matches the frozen specification.

VALIDITY THREAT: The measurement approach captures product pages from 4 task families but computes consistency across the full AX tree. The experiment design intends product-subtree anchoring which was not fully implemented. The 0.0 consistency is a measurement-method artifact, not evidence that full-tree approach fails.

REPRESENTATION LOSS: The experiment measures full-page AX consistency rather than product-subtree consistency. The product-subtree anchor regions (heading, price, add-to-cart, main, contentinfo) were identified but not separately extracted and compared.
unresolved: H1 requires >=5 families but only 4 shopping families are available. shopping_admin (42 families) URLs return 404. Need to either find an accessible admin endpoint or use the 21 distinct product URLs as pseudo-families (each URL is a unique product page).
SHA mutation detection needs verification with a mutation that changes visible content (e.g., changing textContent of an element) rather than a data attribute.

Within-family AX consistency should be computed on product-subtree anchored regions (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo), not full-page AX trees. The full-page 0.0 consistency is a measurement-method artifact.
H2_STAGEHAND_RECOMPUTED cannot be tested because Stagehand is not available in the environment. The SHA recomputation after mutation needs a working Stagehand implementation.
H3 (WebGym diverse census), H4 (Gate0 multi-step), H5 (orthogonal fallback), H6 (WebMCP prevalence) are all MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to substrate unavailability.
